name: proxidAI
description: An accountable agent for local services. Matches people with verified providers nearby, coordinates the work in a job room, and pays per action over x402 on Concordium. It carries its own registered identity, so anyone can check which verified human owns it.

skills.name: Match providers
skills.description: Find verified providers within a radius using PostGIS proximity.

skills.name: Run the job room
skills.description: Coordinate messages, milestones and completion between a client and a provider.

skills.name: Pay per action
skills.description: Settle a payment for a completed action over x402 with sponsored fees.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
